# Continual Flame (`spells:continual-flame`)
**Level 2 [Evocation](../magic-schools/evocation.md)** | **Casting Time:** Action | **Range:** Touch
**Components:** V, S, M (ruby dust worth 50+ GP, which, the spell consumes) | **Duration:** Until dispelled | **Classes:** [Cleric](../classes/cleric.md), [Druid](../classes/druid.md), [Wizard](../classes/wizard.md)

A flame springs from an object that you touch. The effect casts Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. It looks like a regular flame, but it creates no heat and consumes no fuel. The flame can be covered or hidden but not smothered or quenched.
